The call ends with the customer deferring contact until a structure is built, with no appointment, no bill, and no verify items captured.
outcome_dispute: v1 tag is unknown/unclear; the observed outcome is a soft callback deferral with no committed timeframe — closer to no_appointment than a real callback, since the customer controls if/when contact resumes and no date was set.

primary_coaching_focus.quote: I don't have it. I don't even have the pavilion at this point. I just was there was an ad that went on there that showed a pavilion roof with solar panels, and I didn't know if that was something you guys did.
primary_coaching_focus.why: The entire call is spent improvising around a scenario (ad-driven inquiry about a not-yet-built structure) that the standard script has no path for. The rep never names the mismatch or proposes a clean next step, and the call ends with no appointment and no rep-owned follow-up. This is the single highest-leverage fix: give this rep a clear rule for what to do when a lead doesn't fit the standard solar-on-home-roof scenario.
